text:
It is a condition caused by disruption of blood supply to brain cells (either
occlusion (infarction) or blood vessel rupture (haemorrhage). There should be
pathological and/or radiological demonstration of the lesion and the disability
may result in death. The duration of disability is no longer critical. Acute stroke
is referred to as “Brain Attack” because the longer brain cells are deprived of
blood, the bigger the size of the lesion and the more severe the damage or
disability.
